1	/-

     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageAtlas
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.AbelianVariety.GroupSeparated
     8	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Gluing
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Affine intersections in the finite-stage Picard atlas
    12	
    13	The exact separably closed `Pic^0` representer is a group scheme over a field, hence is
    14	separated.  Consequently the intersection of any two affine charts in its chosen finite
    15	atlas is itself affine.  The canonical affine overlap packaged here is the geometric input
    16	for spreading out the finite atlas's restriction maps and gluing data.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	noncomputable section
    28	
    29	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    32	
    33	/-- The finite index type of charts in the chosen atlas of the exact separably closed
    34	`Pic^0` representer. -/
    35	abbrev Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex :=
    36	  { U // U ∈ (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).charts }
    37	
    38	instance : Finite (Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :=
    39	  (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).finite_charts.to_subtype
    40	
    41	/-- Pairwise intersections of charts in the chosen finite atlas of the exact separably
    42	closed `Pic^0` representer are affine.  This uses the group structure transported from
    43	the represented Picard functor, rather than adding separatedness as a hypothesis. -/
    44	theorem pic0FiniteStageAtlas_inter_isAffine
    45	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    46	    IsAffineOpen (U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1) := by
    47	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
    48	  letI : GrpObj J := (picRepDatumSepClosed C).grpObj
    49	  haveI : IsSeparated J.hom := isSeparated_of_grpObj J
    50	  haveI : Scheme.IsSeparated J.left := by
    51	    constructor
    52	    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from J.hom]
    53	    infer_instance
    54	  exact U.1.2.inf V.1.2
    55	
    56	/-- The intersection of two chosen finite-stage charts, regarded canonically as an affine
    57	open of the exact separably closed `Pic^0` representer. -/
    58	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap
    59	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    60	    (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.affineOpens :=
    61	  ⟨U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1, pic0FiniteStageAtlas_inter_isAffine C U V⟩
    62	
    63	@[simp]
    64	theorem pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_open
    65	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    66	    (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1 = U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1 :=
    67	  rfl
    68	
    69	/-- The canonical affine overlap is contained in its left chart. -/
    70	theorem pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left
    71	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    72	    (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1 ≤ U.1.1 :=
    73	  inf_le_left
    74	
    75	/-- The canonical affine overlap is contained in its right chart. -/
    76	theorem pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_right
    77	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    78	    (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1 ≤ V.1.1 :=
    79	  inf_le_right
    80	
    81	/-! ## The canonical finite affine gluing datum -/
    82	
    83	/-- The chosen finite atlas as an actual open cover of the exact separably closed `Pic^0`
    84	representer. -/
    85	noncomputable def pic0SepClosedAtlasOpenCover :
    86	    (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.OpenCover :=
    87	  (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.openCoverOfIsOpenCover
    88	    (fun U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C => U.1.1) (by
    89	      apply TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover.mk
    90	      rw [iSup_subtype'']
    91	      exact (pic0FiniteStageAtlas C).iSup_opens)
    92	
    93	/-- Every object of the chosen finite open cover is affine. -/
    94	instance pic0SepClosedAtlasOpenCover_isAffine (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    95	    IsAffine ((pic0SepClosedAtlasOpenCover C).X U) := by
    96	  change IsAffine U.1.1.toScheme
    97	  exact U.1.2
    98	
    99	/-- The canonical finite affine gluing datum associated by Mathlib to the chosen open cover.
   100	Its transition maps and triple-overlap cocycle are construction output of `gluedCover`; this
   101	does not yet assert that the datum descends to a finite subextension. -/
   102	noncomputable def pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData : Scheme.GlueData :=
   103	  (pic0SepClosedAtlasOpenCover C).gluedCover
   104	
   105	/-- Every pairwise overlap scheme in the canonical finite gluing datum is affine. -/
   106	instance isAffine_pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData_V
   107	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   108	    IsAffine ((pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).V (U, V)) := by
   109	  letI : IsAffine (U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1).toScheme :=
   110	    pic0FiniteStageAtlas_inter_isAffine C U V
   111	  let h := isPullback_opens_inf U.1.1 V.1.1
   112	  change IsAffine
   113	    (pullback ((pic0SepClosedAtlasOpenCover C).f U)
   114	      ((pic0SepClosedAtlasOpenCover C).f V))
   115	  change IsAffine (pullback U.1.1.ι V.1.1.ι)

    26	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isOpenImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)

    11	/-!
    12	# Orbit affineness for the finite-stage Picard glue
    13	
    14	An immersion of the finite-stage glued representative into finite relative projective space
    15	gives the finite-in-affine property, so every orbit of its canonical finite-Galois action lies
    16	in an affine open.  This file records both producers at the exact carrier `P.gluedOver` used by
    17	finite-stage descent.  The projectivity entry point remains as a compatibility wrapper.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	
    22	universe u
    23	
    24	open CategoryTheory
    25	open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	variable {K k F : Type u} [Field K] [Field k] [Field F]
    32	variable [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    33	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of K)))
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (Ck : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    37	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom] [IsProper Ck.hom]
    38	  [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    39	
    40	/-- The group object on the finite-stage glue canonically transported from a
    41	representation of Picard zero. -/
    42	@[implicit_reducible]
    43	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageGrpObjOfRepresentableBy
    44	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
    45	    [Algebra K P.N.1]
    46	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver) :
    47	    GrpObj P.gluedOver :=
    48	  GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy P.gluedOver
    49	    (pic0Functor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C) ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) rep
    50	
    51	/-- Over an algebraically closed finite-stage field, irreducibility and the represented
    52	group law make the glued Picard-zero carrier `FiniteInAffine`.
    53	
    54	This is the exact finite-stage specialization of the algebraic-group translation theorem;
    55	the arbitrary-field descent of that theorem is a separate geometric input. -/
    56	theorem pic0FiniteStageFiniteInAffine_of_isAlgClosed_of_irreducible
    57	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
    58	    [Algebra K P.N.1] [IsAlgClosed P.N.1]
    59	    [IrreducibleSpace P.glueData.glued]
    60	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver) :
    61	    Scheme.FiniteInAffine P.glueData.glued := by
    62	  letI : GrpObj P.gluedOver :=
    63	    pic0FiniteStageGrpObjOfRepresentableBy C Ck P rep
    64	  letI : LocallyOfFiniteType P.gluedOver.hom := by
    65	    change LocallyOfFiniteType P.gluedMap
    66	    infer_instance
    67	  letI : IrreducibleSpace P.gluedOver.left := by
    68	    change IrreducibleSpace P.glueData.glued
    69	    infer_instance
    70	  exact GroupScheme.finiteInAffine_of_isAlgClosed_of_irreducible P.gluedOver
    71	
    72	/-- The represented group law produces orbit affineness on the exact finite-stage carrier
    73	over an algebraically closed field, with no projective-space immersion hypothesis. -/
    74	@[implicit_reducible]
    75	noncomputable def
    76	    pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isAlgClosed_of_irreducible
    77	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
    78	    [Algebra K P.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.N.1] [IsGalois K P.N.1]
    79	    [IsAlgClosed P.N.1] [IrreducibleSpace P.glueData.glued]
    80	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver) :
    81	    (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
    82	  Scheme.orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine _
    83	    (pic0FiniteStageFiniteInAffine_of_isAlgClosed_of_irreducible C Ck P rep)
    84	
    85	/-- A finite-dimensional projective-space immersion makes the finite-stage glue
    86	`FiniteInAffine`. -/
    87	theorem pic0FiniteStageFiniteInAffine_of_isImmersion
    88	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
    89	    {n : Type u} [Finite n]
    90	    (i : P.glueData.glued ⟶ ℙ(n; Spec (.of P.N.1)))
    91	    (hi : IsImmersion i) :
    92	    Scheme.FiniteInAffine P.glueData.glued := by
    93	  letI : IsImmersion i := hi
    94	  exact Scheme.finiteInAffine_of_isImmersion i
    95	    (Scheme.finiteInAffine_projectiveSpace n (Spec (.of P.N.1)))
    96	
    97	/-- A finite-dimensional projective-space immersion supplies orbit affineness for the
    98	canonical action attached to a representation of Picard zero by the finite-stage glue. -/
    99	@[implicit_reducible]
   100	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion
   101	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
   102	    [Algebra K P.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.N.1] [IsGalois K P.N.1]
   103	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
   104	    {n : Type u} [Finite n]
   105	    (i : P.glueData.glued ⟶ ℙ(n; Spec (.of P.N.1)))
   106	    (hi : IsImmersion i) :
   107	    (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
   108	  Scheme.orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine _
   109	    (pic0FiniteStageFiniteInAffine_of_isImmersion Ck P i hi)
   110	
   111	/-- Compatibility wrapper deriving the immersion input from projectivity of the finite-stage
   112	glued morphism. -/
   113	@[implicit_reducible]
   114	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective
   115	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
   116	    [Algebra K P.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.N.1] [IsGalois K P.N.1]
   117	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
   118	    (hproj : P.gluedMap.IsProjective) :
   119	    (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen := by
   120	  obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, -⟩ := hproj
   121	  letI : Finite n := hn
   122	  letI : IsClosedImmersion i := hi
   123	  exact pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion C Ck P rep i
   124	    (inferInstance : IsImmersion i)
   125	
   126	end
   127	
   128	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChange
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Basic geometry of the finite-stage Picard glue
    10	
    11	The finite-stage glue is covered by finitely many affine spectra of explicit
    12	finite-presentation algebras over its field of definition.  Consequently its structure
    13	morphism is locally of finite type and quasi-compact, without any additional geometric
    14	hypothesis on the package.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	variable {k F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F]
    28	variable [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    29	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    32	
    33	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    34	
    35	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    36	-- The chart rings retain two nested finite-subextension tensor products.
    37	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    38	/-- The structure morphism of the finite-stage Picard glue is locally of finite type. -/
    39	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_gluedMap
    40	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    41	    LocallyOfFiniteType P.gluedMap := by
    42	  apply IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_openCover P.glueData.openCover
    43	  intro U
    44	  change LocallyOfFiniteType (P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap)
    45	  rw [glueData_ι_gluedMap C P U]
    46	  exact (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType)).mpr
    47	    (RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
    48	
    49	instance instLocallyOfFiniteTypeGluedMap
    50	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    51	    LocallyOfFiniteType P.gluedMap :=
    52	  locallyOfFiniteType_gluedMap C P
    53	
    54	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    55	-- Unfolding the dependent affine glue identifies its finite spectrum charts.
    56	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    57	/-- The structure morphism of the finite-stage Picard glue is quasi-compact. -/
    58	theorem quasiCompact_gluedMap
    59	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    60	    QuasiCompact P.gluedMap := by
    61	  haveI : Finite P.glueData.openCover.I₀ := by
    62	    change Finite (Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C)
    63	    infer_instance
    64	  haveI : ∀ U, CompactSpace (P.glueData.openCover.X U) := by
    65	    intro U
    66	    change CompactSpace
    67	      (Spec (CommRingCat.of
    68	        (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    69	          C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U)))
    70	    infer_instance
    71	  haveI : CompactSpace P.glueData.glued :=
    72	    P.glueData.openCover.compactSpace
    73	  exact (HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @QuasiCompact)).mpr
    74	    (inferInstance : CompactSpace P.glueData.glued)
    75	
    76	instance instQuasiCompactGluedMap
    77	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    78	    QuasiCompact P.gluedMap :=
    79	  quasiCompact_gluedMap C P
    80	
    81	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    82	
    83	end
    84	
    85	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageOrbitAffine
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteGaloisRepresentable
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Stable affine covers from the finite-stage Picard glue
    11	
    12	This module immediately consumes immersion-based finite-stage orbit affineness in the
    13	stable-cover engine and in the finite-Galois Picard representability theorem.  Projectivity
    14	entry points remain as compatibility wrappers.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    22	open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {K k F : Type u} [Field K] [Field k] [Field F]
    29	variable [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    30	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of K)))
    31	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    32	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    33	variable (Ck : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom] [IsProper Ck.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    36	variable (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
    37	variable [Algebra K P.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.N.1] [IsGalois K P.N.1]
    38	
    39	/-- On an algebraically closed finite-stage field, the represented group structure and
    40	irreducibility produce the stable affine cover directly, without an immersion binder. -/
    41	@[implicit_reducible]
    42	noncomputable def
    43	    pic0FiniteStageHasStableAffineCover_of_isAlgClosed_of_irreducible
    44	    [IsAlgClosed P.N.1] [IrreducibleSpace P.glueData.glued]
    45	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver) :
    46	    HasStableAffineCover K P.N.1
    47	      (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep) := by
    48	  letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
    49	    pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isAlgClosed_of_irreducible C Ck P rep
    50	  infer_instance
    51	
    52	/-- A finite-dimensional projective-space immersion produces the stable affine cover used by
    53	the finite-Galois quotient construction. -/
    54	@[implicit_reducible]
    55	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageHasStableAffineCover_of_isImmersion
    56	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
    57	    {n : Type u} [Finite n]
    58	    (i : P.glueData.glued ⟶ ℙ(n; Spec (.of P.N.1)))
    59	    (hi : IsImmersion i) :
    60	    HasStableAffineCover K P.N.1
    61	      (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep) := by
    62	  letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
    63	    pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion C Ck P rep i hi
    64	  infer_instance
    65	
    66	/-- Compatibility wrapper producing the stable affine cover from projectivity of the
    67	finite-stage glued morphism. -/
    68	@[implicit_reducible]
    69	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageHasStableAffineCover_of_isProjective
    70	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
    71	    (hproj : P.gluedMap.IsProjective) :
    72	    HasStableAffineCover K P.N.1
    73	      (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep) := by
    74	  letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
    75	    pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective C Ck P rep hproj
    76	  infer_instance
    77	
    78	/-- Consume the finite-stage immersion producer in the finite-Galois Picard descent theorem.
    79	The resulting quotient represents Picard zero over the original field. -/
    80	noncomputable def pic0RepresentableBy_finiteStageGaloisDescent_of_isImmersion
    81	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
    82	    {n : Type u} [Finite n]
    83	    (i : P.glueData.glued ⟶ ℙ(n; Spec (.of P.N.1)))
    84	    (hi : IsImmersion i) :
    85	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
    86	      (StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOver
    87	        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)) := by
    88	  letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
    89	    pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion C Ck P rep i hi
    90	  exact pic0RepresentableBy_finiteGaloisDescent C rep
    91	
    92	/-- Consume the algebraically-closed irreducible group producer in finite-Galois Picard
    93	descent.  The arbitrary-field analogue awaits the corresponding algebraic-group
    94	`FiniteInAffine` theorem. -/
    95	noncomputable def
    96	    pic0RepresentableBy_finiteStageGaloisDescent_of_isAlgClosed_of_irreducible
    97	    [IsAlgClosed P.N.1] [IrreducibleSpace P.glueData.glued]
    98	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver) :
    99	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
   100	      (StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOver
   101	        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)) := by
   102	  letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
   103	    pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isAlgClosed_of_irreducible C Ck P rep
   104	  exact pic0RepresentableBy_finiteGaloisDescent C rep
   105	
   106	/-- Compatibility wrapper consuming projectivity in the finite-Galois Picard descent theorem. -/
   107	noncomputable def pic0RepresentableBy_finiteStageGaloisDescent_of_isProjective
   108	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
   109	    (hproj : P.gluedMap.IsProjective) :
   110	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
   111	      (StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOver
   112	        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)) := by
   113	  letI : (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
   114	    pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective C Ck P rep hproj
   115	  exact pic0RepresentableBy_finiteGaloisDescent C rep
   116	
   117	end
   118	
   119	end AlgebraicGeometry
